gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Noto Sans Glagolitic reads open and friendly, with round letters and a sturdy, tall lowercase body. And Audiowide gives it a futuristic header, its tile-like glyphs spaced wide and drawn with a pencil-line consistency.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-alexandria: Alexandria has wide open terminals and a tall body with short stems, giving the text a polished, businesslike look. And Tilt Neon, with its tube-like stroke, wants to be large; at small sizes its splayed c would crowd.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-kannada: Chunky tubes meet woodblock squareness. Tilt Neon is best at loud, bent-paperclip display strokes, while Anek Kannada does its best work in a high x-height with terminals that stop well back from the stem.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-blinker: Bold and commanding, Tilt Neon draws a tube-like stroke with a splayed c, while Blinker keeps its lines steady and its apertures open. Shrink the heading and it loses punch.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Neon tubing in letter form: Tilt Neon holds every stroke to one gauge, with a splayed c. Carrois Gothic SC follows with clear openings at every curve, and capitals and lowercase sit nearly level.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-chivo: Glowing tubes, no hairlines, a big x-height. Tilt Neon is best at bold, unchanging strokes up top; Chivo does its best work below, packing lowercase close to the caps with daylight in every curve.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-comme: Wire-like tubes with a splayed c and a large x-height give Tilt Neon its loud, bold presence. Comme sits below, smooth and modern.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-cossette-texte: Tilt Neon brings a bold, tube-like stroke and a large x-height to the top, and Cossette Texte does the quiet work below with wide-eyed e shapes, sturdy n arches and a prominent x-height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-gafata: Tilt Neon draws a ruler-straight, constant-width line with a splayed c and short ascenders up top. Gafata sits below it, a tall band of lowercase.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-geist: Geist has a quiet, level beat, with no accents of weight and words that form solid blocks. And Tilt Neon's tube-like heading looks best large, so give the heading room above this text.
